label: Creator of all being LORD_1 strengthens LORD_2 being LORD_1
note: Same InAct, CausesIn, esse and IsLord. The strong version gives LORD_1 to every cause of the being of all; the weak one only to such a cause that also governs everything else. Control part 2: a cause of the being of all that governs nothing satisfies the weak version and falsifies the strong one.
